title: Seven student withdrawal files showed aid that never went out

beats.text: At an art college with campuses in San Francisco and Oakland, students who withdrew could still be owed aid.

visual.sub: The test covered seven students with eligible aid

beats.text: Auditors tested 17 files. In seven, eligible aid had not gone out.

visual.kicker: The test covered seven students with eligible aid

beats.text: In 4 of the same 17 files, the college also used the wrong calendar.

visual.kicker: A separate calendar error understated federal returns

beats.text: The amounts returned to federal programs fell short by $974.
An earlier audit found one loan return outside a 45-day window.
The next auditors found the earlier timing procedure appeared effective.

visual.kicker: An earlier late refund had a different outcome

beats.text: The college reported adding manual checks in 2021.

visual.kicker: Management reported changes to the returned-aid process

beats.text: The later records do not document individual receipts for the missing $1,345.

visual.kicker: Management reported changes to the returned-aid process

beats.text: Every source is linked in the case file below.
